units.source_text: 我对小姐和柏木的关系如此的亲密，至今仍是半信半疑。

en.t: Even now, I was still half in doubt that the relationship between the young lady and Kashiwagi had become so intimate.

units.source_text: 我不明白这个难以取悦的女子，为什么对柏木这样一个长着一双X型的腿的穷书生这般殷勤。

en.t: I could not understand why this hard-to-please woman was so attentive to a poor student like Kashiwagi, with his pair of X-shaped legs.

units.source_text: 两三杯酒下肚以后，柏木仿佛回答我的疑问似地说道：

en.t: After two or three cups of sake had gone down, Kashiwagi spoke as if answering my question:
